$comment: Forge portal gate registry. Every gate has a negative control that MUST make it exit non-zero. A gate that passes its own negative control is furniture. The meta-gate (gate-self-test.mjs) runs every gate's NC and fails if any is furniture. States: OBSERVATIONAL | WARNING | BLOCKING. This registry is drift-checked against packages/govern/domains/forge/constitution.json by check-gate-registry-drift.mjs.

contract.negativeControl: a fixture or mutation that makes the gate exit non-zero in under 30 seconds
contract.enforcementMoment: each BLOCKING gate names when it fires

negativeControl.description: a source file containing a raw hex color must make token-audit exit non-zero

gates.scope: manifest integrity + API contract + store + token-audit + build + acceptance

negativeControl.description: a corrupt manifest entry (pack missing on disk) must make the system test exit non-zero
